d:
Khichri se bor? banaie kurkura phalahari dosa aur garam sup
Poonam Devnani ki 2 naee phalahari resipi: bina soda dosa + sabudana-makhana sup
1 aloo se 5 crispy Falahari Dosa, bina soda
Sabudana, makhana, aloo aur nuts wala garam soup
Vrat masala: jeera, kali mirch, sendha namak
Is Navratri vrat mein kuch naya banana chahte hain? Ye dono recipes ghar ke saamaan se ban jaati hain, aur poora parivaar pasand karega. Comment karein: vrat mein dosa ya soup pehle banaya hai? Kaisa laga?
